new_burn_metrics.description: Six pooled metrics for every checkpoint, retaining infinite/undefined values distinctly.

new_burn_architectures.description: All finite checkpoint scores by architecture, plus Brier/AP scatter; box plots describe checkpoint distributions.

new_burn_distances.description: Eight representative displays for all nine exact/floored KL and Bernoulli probability-distance fields; total variation equals Wasserstein-1 for unit distance on {0,1}. Infinity and undefined values retained separately.

new_burn_reliability.description: Fixed-bin reliability small multiples; empty bins omitted and marker size reflects bin population.

new_burn_event_brier.description: Per-event pooled Brier heatmap for display representatives; unavailable event scores remain gray.

new_burn_coverage.description: Native availability and shared-model retention for every checkpoint; coverage versus shared-cohort Brier.

new_burn_curves.description: Complete pooled ROC and step precision-recall curves for display representatives; single-class/empty support recorded.

pooling: equal-cell-cutoff entries pooled before scoring; event scores separately pooled within event
display_selection: At most 20 checkpoints: lowest Brier within each architecture (forest/Bayesian families first if needed), then lowest remaining Brier; id breaks ties. Display only, no fitting or checkpoint selection.
numeric_policy: Finite values use numeric axes; triangles outside the finite axis mark infinity; crosses outside the axis mark undefined/missing. Values are never replaced with zero or finite loss caps.
uncertainty: Descriptive evaluation scores and reliability bins; no confidence intervals for evaluation metrics. Pointwise simulation intervals describe Monte Carlo error only.
distance_space: Per-cell Bernoulli outcome distributions on {0,1} with unit ground distance; not geographic transport or joint-map distance
